---
title: "Popconfirm"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
source(file.path("..", "..", "shots.R"))
```

A simple confirmation of a click. `input$<id>_confirm` and
`input$<id>_cancel` report the answer.

## Basic usage

```{r basic, eval = FALSE, shot = TRUE, shot_js = "document.querySelector('#shot button').click()", shot_sel = ".el-popover", shot_wait = 1}
el_popconfirm("del", reference = el_button("del_btn", "Delete"),
              title = "Are you sure to delete this?")
```

## Customise

```{r custom, eval = FALSE, shot = TRUE, shot_js = "document.querySelector('#shot button').click()", shot_sel = ".el-popover", shot_wait = 1}
el_popconfirm("good", reference = el_button("go", "Delete"), title = "Are you sure to delete this?",
              confirm_button_text = "OK", cancel_button_text = "No, Thanks",
              icon = "el-icon-info", icon_color = "red")
```

## API

```{r api, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
api_tables("popconfirm")
```
